label: At most one actual being has its esse identical with its essence
paraphrase: Any two beings in act as to being whose represented esse equals their represented essence are the same being. Only 'at most one': that some such being exists is not asserted. De ente c.3 [69874] (Baur/Koch; Leonine c.4): 'talis res, quae sit suum esse, non potest esse nisi una'; the passage's claim is not restricted to beings in act, so this restricted version is weaker than the passage. No modal necessity, simplicity, concreteness or God identification is part of it.
